description: This file defines the DoctrineCacheAdapter class, which implements cache interface functionality by wrapping a Doctrine cache object. It provides methods for common cache operations such as get, set, delete, and contains, delegating to the underlying Doctrine cache.

classes.name: DoctrineCacheAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class implementing cache interface by wrapping a Doctrine cache object, facilitating cache operations via delegation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a Doctrine Cache instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by key using Doctrine's fetch method.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Alias for get method, retrieves a cache item by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a cache item with the specified key, value, and TTL via Doctrine's save method.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Alias for set method, stores a cache item with the specified parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cache item by key using Doctrine's delete method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Alias for remove method, deletes a cache item by key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a cache item exists for the given key using Doctrine's contains method.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Retrieves cache statistics via Doctrine's getStats method.
